turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, am I speaking with Mr Rohan? This is Vikram from Suraksha Health. You filled in our form for health insurance.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. So who do you want to cover, and what is your age?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Me and my wife. I'm 36 and she's 33. Actually my parents are 61 and 64 and they don't have any health insurance at all.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, noted. Which city are you in?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: For you and your wife, 10 lakh cover would be around fifteen thousand rupees a year.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fifteen thousand? That's too expensive for us.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It's a good plan, sir. Most people take it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hmm. And if my wife gets hospitalised, will the claim actually be paid?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Don't worry, your claim will definitely be approved, a hundred percent.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that sounds good. How do I sign up?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Also, this call is recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And your parents can be added to Family Shield since they are under 65.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, please send me the quote.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, I will send it on WhatsApp in a few minutes.
